glosses: flute (woodwind instrument consisting of a tube with a row of holes that produce sound through vibrations caused by air blown across the edge of the holes, often tuned by plugging one or more holes with a finger)
flute (glass with a long, narrow bowl and a long stem, used for drinking wine, especially champagne)
Originally meaning fluyt, by the late 17th century used for any large cargo vessel

examples.text: Il sait jouer de la flûte.
Je ne sais pas jouer de la flûte.
examples.en: I don't know how to play the flute.

examples.text: Tom aime aussi jouer de la flûte.
examples.en: Tom also likes to play the flute.
